goal: Build a tiny Python CLI todo app: a package todo/ run as `python -m todo.cli` with commands `add TEXT`, `list` and `done N` (1-based index). Todos are stored as JSON in the file named by the TODO_FILE environment variable (default todos.json). Add a README.md and a unittest suite under tests/ that passes. Standard library only; the interpreter on this host is /usr/bin/python3.11.

phases.name: Implement add/list/done
phases.done_when: add, list and done work against TODO_FILE
phases.check: rm -f .jevflow/smoke.json && export TODO_FILE=.jevflow/smoke.json && /usr/bin/python3.11 -m todo.cli add 'buy milk' && /usr/bin/python3.11 -m todo.cli list | grep -q 'buy milk' && /usr/bin/python3.11 -m todo.cli done 1 && /usr/bin/python3.11 -m todo.cli list | grep -q 'buy milk'

phases.name: README
phases.done_when: README.md documents the three commands and TODO_FILE

phases.name: Tests pass
phases.done_when: tests/ has unittest tests for add, list and done and they all pass

phases.name: Debug failing tests
phases.done_when: the failing tests are diagnosed from their output and fixed
